changeSet.comment: nexus.reaper_quarantine_chunks: the periodic reaper's move. Selects with nexus.chunk_is_reapable (injectable grace), takes the exclusive sweep gate, refuses a move over the fraction floor, copies to the quarantine sibling through the DELETE's own RETURNING with the predicate in the DELETE's WHERE, tags every moved chunk quarantined_by=engine-reaper, writes one actor engine-reaper gc_audit row. Dry-run form counts only.

rollback.sql: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS nexus.reaper_quarantine_chunks(text, text, text, text, int, interval, float8, int, boolean);

changeSet.author: nexus-2x9xa
changeSet.comment: nexus.reaper_owns_quarantined_row(metadata) and nexus.reaper_expire_quarantine: the one definition of the engine-owned-row predicate (quarantined_by=engine-reaper and reaper_quarantined_at equal to quarantined_at; total, false when a stamp is missing), then the engine's expiry of the chunks the reaper moved. The expiry deletes at most p_row_limit rows the predicate owns, past the cutoff, with no manifest row of the origin naming them, no fraction floor; returns expired and protected_count (manifest-named); one engine-reaper gc_audit row per call that deletes.

rollback.sql: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS nexus.reaper_expire_quarantine(text, text, text, text, int); DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS nexus.reaper_owns_quarantined_row(jsonb);
